summary.intent: Execute Phase 24 (bug fixes and test infrastructure), get the PR merged, and fix a newly added recovery E2E test that was consistently failing in CI.
summary.outcome: Phase 24 executed and merged successfully. The recovery E2E test root cause was identified: the SDK's createTestAccount never publishes the vault key blob IPNS record (only the web app's useAuth hook does), making recovery impossible in tests. A fix was started to move vault key blob publish into sdk-core.

repo: The vault key blob IPNS record is published exclusively by the web app's useAuth hook (deriveVaultKeyIpnsKeypair + serializeVaultBlobV2 + createAndPublishIpnsRecord), not by the SDK — creating a gap in createTestAccount and any non-web client.
In CI, IPNS records are published through mock-ipns-routing (port 3001) via delegated routing, not through Kubo's DHT — Kubo's gateway cannot resolve these names.
The API's /ipns/resolve endpoint requires JWT auth (JwtAuthGuard on the entire IpnsController), making it unreachable from unauthenticated tools like recovery.html.

The CipherBox API publishes IPNS records via delegated routing (mock-ipns-routing in CI, someguy in prod), not directly through Kubo's name/publish — so Kubo's local IPNS resolver won't have records either.
recovery.html window.location.origin.replace(/:\d+$/, ':3000') correctly derives the API base from any Vite dev server port.
The mock-ipns-routing server (tools/mock-ipns-routing) is a simple Fastify server with no CORS headers by default.
validateRegistryShape() narrows obj.devices inside its scope but TypeScript doesn't propagate narrowing across function call boundaries — callers need an explicit cast after calling it.
publishWithVerify was originally re-publishing on every retry instead of publishing once and only retrying the verification step.
useAuth.ts was inlining 7 lines of SHA-256 for ipHash when computeIpHash() already exists in the device/info module.
Stale package builds (.d.ts files) in @cipherbox/crypto and @cipherbox/api-client caused 6 false type errors in the web app — pnpm --filter build regenerates them.

The recovery.html resolveIpns fallback chain: (1) /ipns/ HEAD on gateway with 30s timeout, (2) /routing/v1/ipns/:name with 3 retries + backoff, (3) CipherBox API /ipns/resolve (requires auth), (4) POST /api/v0/name/resolve on IPFS node.

code.finding: publishWithVerify was calling createAndPublishIpnsRecord on every retry iteration — should publish once then loop only on the verification fetch.
Vault key blob IPNS publish lives here (deriveVaultKeyIpnsKeypair + serializeVaultBlobV2 + addToIpfs + createAndPublishIpnsRecord) — not in the SDK, causing createTestAccount to skip it entirely.

validateV2Registry uses validateRegistryShape() but TypeScript cannot narrow obj.devices after the call — needs explicit as unknown[] cast. Also: migration should only auto-heal empty string ipHash, not other malformed values.

createTestAccount calls initializeVault, registers vault, creates CipherBoxClient, registers root folder — but never publishes the vault key blob IPNS record, making recovery.html unable to find the vault.
Expected sequenceNumber: 0 for fresh bin, but after adding auto-repair in loadBin, a fresh bin now immediately publishes and returns sequenceNumber: 1.
Same sequenceNumber assertion needed updating after auto-repair change.

let cid declared inside try block is not accessible in finally block — must be hoisted above try. Also: let cid!: string with definite assignment weakens type safety vs string | undefined with narrowing.
No CORS headers — browser cannot make cross-origin requests from localhost:5173. Added CORS with GET and OPTIONS only.

IPNS_GATEWAY should default to DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL (mock-ipns-routing) not API URL or hardcoded port. IPFS_GATEWAY should default to Kubo gateway port 8080. All env vars should use .trim() || default pattern.
Error message said only hex accepted but code had vestigial base64 fallback from old export-file mode — removed. Also: base64 branch was dead code since v2 recovery only uses hex keys.

Web E2E step sets TEST_LOGIN_SECRET for the API but not SDK_E2E_SECRET for the test runner process — CipherBoxClient test harness reads SDK_E2E_SECRET and falls back to a different default, causing 401 on /auth/test-login.

workflow: When a TypeScript narrowing function is extracted from inline control flow, callers lose the narrowed type — add explicit casts at call sites or use assertion function signature.

Browser CORS issues with local services (Kubo, mock routing) are a recurring friction point for E2E tests — configure CORS at the service level in CI rather than proxying through authenticated services.

Debugging E2E test failures: download Playwright artifacts (error-context.md, screenshots) from CI to understand exactly where in the page flow the failure occurs rather than guessing from test output alone.

When a test helper (createTestAccount) builds a partial representation of a user session, any functionality added to the full client-side flow afterward silently diverges — SDK should be the source of truth for all vault operations.
pnpm --filter @scope/package build must be re-run after changing package exports for downstream TypeScript to pick up new .d.ts files.
Verifying Git push via background tasks can produce spurious failures if a foreground push already completed — background task failure exit code 128 (not a repo) is a false alarm in this scenario.
The GSD execute-phase classifyHandoffIfNeeded bug: agents can report 'failed' after completing all work — spot-check SUMMARY.md + git commits to distinguish real failure from Claude Code runtime bug.
Kubo in CI with mock-ipns-routing: only records published through delegated routing exist in the mock; Kubo's local IPNS store is separate and empty.

friction: Recovery E2E test required 5 separate PRs (#361, #363, #364, #365, #367) and extensive debugging before root cause (missing vault key blob publish in SDK) was found.
GitHub API timeouts during CI log fetching forced multiple retries and delays in diagnosing failures.
Background bash tasks produced spurious exit-128 failures when a foreground push had already completed, causing confusion.
Each recovery test CI run takes ~8 minutes, making the debug loop very slow.
Kubo has no CORS configured by default — required a CI workflow step to configure it, which was still insufficient since IPNS records weren't in Kubo at all.

The mock-ipns-routing /routing/v1/ipns/:name endpoint returns a raw binary IPNS record (application/vnd.ipfs.ipns-record), and recovery.html's protobuf parser silently failed to extract the CID, falling through all fallbacks without a clear error.
Docker host IP changed (192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12) mid-session, requiring .env update and surfacing the gateway URL assumptions baked into the recovery test.
Git stash was needed mid-session when user wanted to switch branches with uncommitted recovery.spec.ts changes.
Pre-existing type errors in the codebase (stale .d.ts builds, byo-file-workload.ts cid scoping) were conflated with phase 24 changes during review.
open_items: Extract vault key blob IPNS publish from useAuth.ts into sdk-core (publishVaultKeyBlob / loadVaultKeyBlob functions) — branch feat/sdk-vault-key-blob-publish started but not yet merged.
Update createTestAccount to call publishVaultKeyBlob so recovery E2E test works without test.skip.
Remove test.skip(!!process.env.CI) from recovery.spec.ts once SDK vault key blob publish is wired in.
Configure Kubo CORS locally (ipfs config --json API.HTTPHeaders for port 5001 and 8080) on Docker host 192.168.133.12 to enable local recovery E2E testing without needing CI.
Consider whether /ipns/resolve API endpoint should have an optional public mode or separate unauthenticated endpoint for the recovery tool use case.
PR #367 (recovery test CI skip) was created but may be superseded by the SDK vault key blob fix — evaluate whether to merge or close it.
